title: Security Master export (chester-reports -> chester-meme)
description: Contract for exports/security_master.json, written nightly by chester-reports and imported read-only by chester-meme (spec v1 section 3). chester-meme never modifies this file; names it meets that the export lacks are written to drop/sm-proposals.jsonl.

schema_version.description: 1.1 (16 Oct 2026) adds the optional restricted and restricted_reason; a 1.0 document is a valid 1.1 document.

exported_at.description: UTC, ISO-8601 with Z. Used as available_at for the import.

active.description: Defaults to true when any ticker_history row is open.

restricted.description: Since 1.1. true = a standing trading restriction applies (Brookfield-related securities). Written on every security, false included: where present it decides the security in chester-meme; absent = no statement, and chester-meme's own list decides.

restricted_reason.description: Since 1.1. Free text kept with the restriction, e.g. 'Brookfield complex: tier 3 preferred'. Present only when restricted is true.

ticker.description: ACT/CQS form, share class with a dot: BRK.B
